parameters.name: AcwCookieStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the tracking cookie.

- **0**: Disabled.

- **1 (default)**: Enabled.

parameters.name: AcwSecureStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the secure attribute of the tracking cookie.

- **0 (default)**: Disabled.

- **1**: Enabled.

parameters.name: AcwV3SecureStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the secure attribute of the slider CAPTCHA cookie.

- **0 (default)**: Disabled.

- **1**: Enabled.

parameters.name: CustomHeaders
parameters.description:
The custom header fields.

> The first IP address in the specified header field is used as the client source IP address to prevent X-Forwarded-For (XFF) spoofing. If multiple headers are specified, they are tried in sequence to obtain the source IP address. If the first header does not contain an IP address, the system tries the second header, and so on. If no IP address is found in any of the specified headers, the system uses the first IP address in the X-Forwarded-For header.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The name of the protected object.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: Specifies the key for a custom response header.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: Specifies the value for a custom response header.

parameters.name: XffStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether a Layer 7 proxy is deployed in front of WAF. Layer 7 proxies include Anti-DDoS Proxy and Alibaba Cloud CDN. Valid values:

- **0 (default)**: No.

- **1**: Yes.
